body:
Another unadmitted original, **0522**, independently reproduces this limitation along X as well as Y.

Exact replay of its untouched original SVG (SHA-256 `352a8b42a860c03617a356e48b1c75e2e8e4411d927463a5d138590857fa19c4`) gives four 120×120 plots on a 360×388 canvas:

| Panel | X | Y | Vertices |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Congo_DR | 0 | 0 | 47 |
| Japan | 188 | 0 | 47 |
| Kenya | 0 | 167 | 47 |
| UK | 177 | 167 | 47 |

These are actual original browser scenegraph cell origins. The source uses `encoding.facet: {field: 'country', columns: 2, title: null}`, independent Y scales, and a fold of Kenya/Congo_DR/UK/Japan. All 47 raw CSV rows remain unchanged; the original fold yields 188 line vertices. Its compiled bounds-driven layout gives different second-column origins (188 versus 177); one common column track cannot express both.

No School request, translated program, image inspection, admission or completion count was made for this source. Fold data support already exists in the local candidate; this is a separate composition layout requirement. Local evidence: `tmp/total1500-0522-actual-original-source-capture-v1/{proof.json,root.json,panels.json,dom.json,text-dom.json,reference/compiled.vega.json,reference/chart.svg}`. Original source SHA-256: `c2069f650a71f5cd77ad73a2ddc183a9f165719a2a40b17acf230dbe5c30817f`.

Additional reproduced single-row case: source family 0628 also needs this full-bounds layout capability; it remains unadmitted and uncounted, with zero model requests.

The original has 747 unchanged CSV rows, three 150 × 200 plots, 2,241 line vertices, independent Y domains [0,13], [0,500], [0,40], and a 581 × 313 outer canvas. Plot X origins relative to the first plot are **0,199,393**, requiring unequal neighboring plot gaps **49,44**. The original layout declares columns:4 and align:each; only three values exist.

Actual public high-level probes against the unpublished bb73836f candidate retain all vertices and domains:

| Scalar plot gap | Native relative plot origins | Native outer size |
|---|---|---|
| 44 | 0,194,388 | 576 × 313 |
| 49 | 0,199,398 | 586 × 313 |

A scalar gap cannot satisfy both desired neighbor intervals. Adjusting outer width alone would leave panel positions wrong.

Original panel header tops are **63,58,58**. Existing mark-content anchoring gives **63,63,63**: the latter two original headers account for top Y-label overflow. Current content anchoring intentionally unions mark owners with plots, so this calls for the requested full-content flow including retained guides, rather than silently changing existing mark-only semantics. Shared X footer axes and independent Y guide owners must survive.

Source SHA-256: `2f812401252565c29179949e75a7afe1e0c762f784dbb7011a0900d812d44837`.
Raw SHA-256: `25461ee4c9e0774a6ba89d91e28715f448c8592ef35ed7b9627038bde5ef1126`.
Original SVG SHA-256: `bd00e6a8043c6acbe46f55fd7816265af1ab363c72afd4ed37e98bd397c4ac7c`.

No chart-image inspection, data substitution, raw-row edits or fidelity waiver was used. Local evidence: `v12-source0628-independent-full-bounds-layout-hold-v1.json`. The first private fold probe rejected alias GDP because that raw column already exists; the corrected public fold uses a fresh value alias and preserves the original raw GDP values. That alias adjustment requires no library extension.

The pure layout foundation is now committed at [838d8544](https://github.com/ggaction/ggaction/commit/838d8544). This does **not** finish or publish the feature; no public action is wired to the new kernel yet.

Implemented and tested:

- Immutable full-content flow with independent origins, stable logical order, ragged rows, outward integer clearance, finite-overflow rejection and malformed-input validation.
- Shared footer calculation uses each column's last logical occupied cell and a common trailing edge. It does not add one X axis per panel.
- When given independently captured original group bounds, the kernel exactly reconstructs all seven plot origins and five shared-footer origins across the two reproduced source cases.
- 3,893 unit tests, 71 layout tests and four package-contract checks pass. Package staging passes; only the actual extra module entry and measured packed-size ceilings were adjusted minimally, with prior failures retained.

Remaining before this issue can close:

- Measure actual native mark/guide/header content and connect the public materializer, replay, persistence, types and docs.
- Preserve existing plot/canvas spacing and mark-only header anchoring.
- Qualify the full native outputs against both original sources. Source-fed arithmetic alone is not native fidelity evidence: for the current 0628 native child bounds, the same calculation yields X origins **0,196,386**, while the source requires **0,199,393**. Existing logical text/baseline and stroke bounds differ, and the current mark-only header anchor omits axis overflow. This discrepancy remains explicit; no source coordinate-array injection or tolerance waiver is used.

Both original families remain unadmitted/untranslated/un-counted with zero School calls. Translation still uses the unchanged previously verified bb73836f local candidate; this partial development commit has not been installed or released. Design and kernel validation: [PROPOSAL.md](https://github.com/ggaction/ggaction/blob/838d8544/agent_docs/impl/facet-content-flow/PROPOSAL.md), [KERNEL_VALIDATION.json](https://github.com/ggaction/ggaction/blob/838d8544/agent_docs/impl/facet-content-flow/KERNEL_VALIDATION.json).

Native content measurement preparation is now committed and pushed in 2b48b801 and documentation provenance 35d1c407. It measures retained native marks/guides/owned headers and separates footer bounds using the same guide-ownership planner as actual materialization. All 5,301 normal tests, 17 focused tests, 121 documentation tests and the exact installed package consumer passed.

This does not yet expose spacing:"content" or connect the public layout. The native diagnostic caught an ownership mismatch: a source that retains each Y axis but shares X needs an explicit per-channel policy; measuring already-removed internal axes would produce incorrect packed widths. The pending integration is documented in agent_docs/impl/facet-content-flow/INTEGRATION_PLAN.md. No translation count, active translation runtime, public release or issue-completion claim changed. This issue remains open.

Closeout review after [ggaction 0.0.22](https://github.com/ggaction/ggaction/releases/tag/v0.0.22):

The pure full-bounds flow kernel and native measurement preparation are included, but public independent wrapped packing and shared footer axis ownership are not wired. This remains incomplete; the blocked source is not admitted or counted in the 1,336-family cohort.

Keeping this issue open. The release/branch cleanup does not mark preparation or a workaround as a finished public capability.
